sources.title: hotchpotch/bekko-embedding-v1-a25m · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: bekko-embedding-v1-a25m is an ultra-compact multilingual text embedding model. It has just 25M active parameters — light enough to run comfortably on modest CPUs — yet its retrieval quality is comparable to models with 3-10x more active parameters. For a smaller, faster model, see bekko-embedding-v1-a8m (8M active parameters).

sources.title: hotchpotch/bekko-embedding-v1-a25m
sources.snippet: Bekko Embedding is an ultra-compact (AP 25m), high-performance multilingual model. Fast on CPUs, with 8K token inputs and 384/256/128/64D outputs.

sources.title: Bekko Embedding: Parameter-Efficient Multilingual Retrieval
sources.snippet: Bekko minimizes exactly these: the released models, bekko-embedding-v1-a8m 1 and the higher-quality bekko-embedding-v1-a25m 2 (below, a8m / a25m), have just under 8M and 25M AP. The recipe is deliberately simple.

sources.title: hotchpotch/bekko-embedding-v1-a25m-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: It is available in the hotchpotch/bekko-embedding-v1-a25m source repository when maximum throughput is the priority. The source model also provides the original SentenceTransformers model and its full model card.

sources.title: Bekko Embedding: Parameter-Efficient Multilingual Retrieval with Ultra ...
sources.snippet: This work applied Active Parameters (AP)—the chief determinant of inference compute—consistently as the efficiency axis for multilingual embedding models (building on the non-embedding-parameter view of Kaplan et al., 2020 and Lan et al., 2019) and, on that axis, built the ultra-compact multilingual embedding family Bekko Embedding.
